request.user_text:
SCENE HEADING: EXT. MUMBAI ROOFTOP — SUNSET

ACTION / DESCRIPTION:
EXT. MUMBAI ROOFTOP — SUNSET
A motorcycle tears across adjoining rooftops.
A drone follows while fireworks explode over the skyline.
Rain begins as the rider jumps to an adjacent building.

output.scene_summary: A high-speed motorcycle chase across Mumbai rooftops at sunset, featuring a drone tracking the action, background fireworks, and a dramatic jump to an adjacent building as rain begins to fall.

elements.name: Rider
elements.description: The protagonist/motorcycle rider performing the rooftop escape. Requires a professional stunt double.

elements.name: Motorcycle Rooftop Gap Jump
elements.description: High-risk motorcycle jump from one rooftop to an adjacent building. Requires a professional stunt rider, custom ramps, and landing deceleration systems.
elements.safety_notes: Extremely high-risk. Requires structural engineering approval of rooftops and landing airbag/catch systems.

elements.name: Hero Stunt Motorcycle
elements.description: Lightweight, high-performance dirt/enduro bike modified for rooftop traction and jumping.
elements.safety_notes: Tires must be checked for optimal grip before every take.

elements.name: Rain FX System
elements.description: Overhead rain bars/towers to simulate rain starting mid-scene.
elements.safety_notes: Water on rooftops increases slip hazards for both motorcycle and crew.

elements.name: Ramp and Rig Removal
elements.description: Digital removal of motorcycle takeoff/landing ramps, safety wires, and catch nets.

elements.name: CGI Fireworks & Skyline Enhancement
elements.description: Digital fireworks in the background to ensure safety of the drone and stunt rider, plus Mumbai skyline extensions.

elements.name: FPV Tracking Drone
elements.description: High-speed camera drone to chase the motorcycle across rooftops.
elements.safety_notes: Must maintain safe distance from stunt rider and crew.

elements.name: Stunt Rider Wardrobe (Wet/Dry Duplicates)
elements.description: Weatherproof tactical riding gear with integrated body armor. Multiple duplicates needed for wet/dry continuity.

elements.name: Rooftop Edge Fall Arrest Systems
elements.description: Safety lines, harnesses, and perimeter netting for crew and non-riding stunt personnel near rooftop edges.
elements.safety_notes: Mandatory for all crew members working within 2 meters of the roof edge.

elements.name: Engineered Jump Ramps
elements.description: Custom-built, structurally certified takeoff and landing ramps disguised or painted for digital removal.
elements.safety_notes: Must be anchored securely to the building structure.

stop_conditions: Wind speeds exceeding 25 km/h (hazardous for drone flight and motorcycle jump stability).
Unplanned wet surfaces on the takeoff ramp prior to the jump (loss of traction).
Loss of direct line-of-sight or radio communication with the tracking drone.
Structural compromise or weight limit warning on either rooftop.
continuity_notes: Rain progression: The scene starts dry and rain begins mid-jump. Wardrobe and motorcycle surfaces must match this transition in subsequent shots.
Sunset lighting: Golden hour matching across all coverage angles, requiring tight shooting windows or digital color grading matching.
Motorcycle damage: Any scuffs or dirt acquired during the rooftop run must match subsequent scenes.
